exposure: Neonates born to mothers with SARS-CoV-2 infection
severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection
cohort: 60 pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 infection at Asan Medical Center in Korea between September 1, 2020 and April 26, 2022
finding: Pregnant Korean women with SARS-CoV-2 infection had favorable obstetric outcomes, and the risk of vertical transmission to their neonates was low.
mod_finding: Of the 60 pregnant women in the study, a majority (66.7%) gave birth by cesarean section.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 38 weeks
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of neonates was 3,137 g
